g.text: Verified Institute-Based Alumni-Student Networking Platform • Complete Mongoose Schema Model & Relationship Architecture
MENTORSHIP | REFERRAL | INTERNSHIP_HELP | JOB_GUIDANCE | PROJECT_GUIDANCE | HIGHER_STUDIES | GENERAL_CAREER_ADVICE
INTERNSHIP | JOB | REFERRAL | HACKATHON | SCHOLARSHIP | PROJECT | HIGHER_STUDIES | OTHER
GENERAL | ACADEMIC | PLACEMENT | ALUMNI | EVENT | URGENT | OTHER
WEBINAR | WORKSHOP | MEETUP | PLACEMENT_DRIVE | ALUMNI_TALK | NETWORKING | OTHER
14 Types: CONNECTION_*, GUIDANCE_*, OPPORTUNITY_*, ALUMNI_*, NEW_EVENT, NEW_ANNOUNCEMENT, GENERAL
Primary Key: MongoDB Unique Object Identifier (_id)
Foreign Key: Mongoose ObjectId reference (ref: Collection Model)
Unique Field / Composite Index Constraint (e.g. Email, Connection pairs)
Polymorphic Dynamic Reference (via relatedModel and relatedId)
One-to-One (1:1): Strict unique reference (User <--> Student/Alumni Profile)
One-to-Many (1:N): Institutional tenancy scoping & creator ownership
• Student <--> Alumni Connections mediated via ConnectionRequest table.
• Student <--> Alumni Mentorship mediated via GuidanceRequest table.
• Data Isolation: Institute ObjectId embedded in all institutional data models.
• Role-Based Access Control: SUPER_ADMIN, INSTITUTE_ADMIN, STUDENT, ALUMNI.
• Verification Gate: AlumniProfile requires verifiedBy before student discovery.
• Security: Passwords salted (rounds: 10), select: false on all default queries.
• Compound Uniqueness: { student, alumni } & { institute, rollNumber }.
AlumniConnect MERN Stack Architecture • Verified MongoDB/Mongoose Schemas in server/src/models/*.js • B.Tech Capstone Project Report
